adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Semantic validators (LLM calls) run outside the writer. When committing a ValidationRecord they check that curvec(j) is still the vector they validated against, and if it is not they discard the result and re-queue. This maps to SD10's per-(RuleId,curvec) key.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: OperationValidatorExtension accept / reject / accept_with(enrichment) + on_*_complete post-hooks
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: This is the Hindsight adapter's plug-in point. on_retain_complete, on_consolidate_complete and the memory-update/invalidate post-hooks emit events to the ctxd outbox, and validate_memory_update can refuse curation edits without expected_head (optional strict mode). The same accept/reject/accept_with shape is reused for UltraCode's gate response.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Hybrid recall (semantic + BM25 + graph/temporal, RRF k=60, rerank, max_tokens)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (both)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: UltraCode builds no retrieval of its own. ctx_recall proxies the host's recall, maps each hit to a (logical, revision), then filters and annotates by SD13 precedence (CERTIFIED/PENDING/STALE). By default only certifiable heads are returned, which addresses Graphiti's verified gap where expired edges are returned by default.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Scope lanes: shared repo lane / personal lane / ancestor-directory tags / wildcard rejection
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (dir narrows only the shared lane)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Each logical item carries repo_id/dirs[]/user/session/agent. The principal is part of Certified's Authorized(principal,r) (SD11). Wildcard identities are rejected.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: git_sha/branch provenance captured per session (RepoContext)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (captured but never compared against HEAD; sent to the Platform endpoint)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: The capture logic is reused: every revision written from a hook automatically records code_commit. UltraCode adds the step mem0 skipped, comparing at read time and action time.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Code dependencies pinned by symbol-anchored content hash (path, symbol, span-sha256) + hard/soft staleness tiers
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (TS/JS symbol anchoring); the hard/soft tiers are partially verified (prCheck actually uses recallHardStaleReason)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: A new Evidence logical kind, code://repo/path#symbol, whose revision id is span_sha256 (falling back to the git blob OID). A watcher triggered by git post-commit/checkout moves the head. Revisions with a Cur incidence on it go STALE; those with Sem go PENDING. Tier C stars, but no higher-starred project has a verified equivalent: mem0 only stores git_sha and deja-vu only uses git log as a hint. Adopted for that reason.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Dual-revision attribution: each memory revision records the Code-Commit it was verified against
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially (the walk uses git log --date-order; existence checks happen in the callers)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Revisions and certificates both store verified_code_commit, so 'which code state was this context verified against' can be answered at gate time. The blob-equality fast path runs before semantic comparison.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Revision-pinned compiled context + a <memory_update> delta message to keep the prompt cache
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially (LocalBackend only)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: A UserPromptSubmit hook compares the session's certificate with current heads. If anything changed, it injects a delta message listing the changed items and their new status, instead of rewriting the system prompt, so the LLM prompt cache stays warm.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Isolated worktree branches for background writers + typed merge outcomes (no_changes/dirty/parent_dirty/merge_conflict/merged)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially (the memory-worker path is weaker than reflection)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Background consolidation and semantic-validation agents write into a staged branch namespace, based on a revision. Merge returns typed outcomes. Unlike Letta, conflicts are judged per item by CAS plus read-set validation, not by text diff.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Token-fenced idempotent claims keyed by state signature (repair/revalidation dedup)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (single slot)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Revalidation jobs are deduplicated by (RuleId, curvec) signature with a token fence. A late worker cannot overwrite a newer claim. Changed from Letta's single slot to a table keyed by signature.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Row/cell-level 3-way merge DiffOp taxonomy + conflicts/violations stored as artifacts that block commit
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Merging alternatives across branches (M2) reuses the one-sided/convergent/divergent-resolved/divergent-conflict classification. Conflicts, pending validations and violated invariants are written to an artifacts table keyed by (item, revision, type), which maps to SD17 Conflicted and blocks Certified.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Read-set recording + fixpoint propagation to the cache along consumption edges (turn→feedback→lesson)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (triggers only on hard delete, and deletes rather than marks)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Confirms that real systems need 'record which items a read used'. UltraCode makes the read set an explicit certificate (item, rev, layer status) and replaces 'delete the contaminated cache' with L2 propagation that marks PENDING/STALE.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Refcounted multi-owner sets + idempotent cross-store deletes, vectors first
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially (key format is wrong; only surviving owners are stripped)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: When projecting to the host's vector index, UltraCode deletes projections first, then retracts in ContextDB, then cleans up. Every step is idempotent so retries converge. The owner set is generalized to an AND/OR support count.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Bi-temporal fields + interval-overlap tie-break (skip non-overlapping intervals, later valid_at wins)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (no supersession when valid_at is None; the exact-text fast path skips contradiction checks)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: V0 models transaction time only (SD16). An LLM contradiction verdict is not written as FALSE. It creates a Sem/conflict artifact and puts the item into PENDING. The interval rule is only a suggested ordering for automatic resolution. Graphiti's gap, that invalidated_by is never persisted, becomes an explicit justification edge that can be reversed.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Session-scoped lazy version pinning (first pin wins; reads inject version, writes inject expected_version)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially (COS-KV backend pins have no TTL; errors silently degrade)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: This is the proven form of a certified read. UltraCode generalizes it from skills to every item: the first read in a session records (logical, rev) into the certificate, and later writes automatically carry expected_head. Unlike TencentDB, a degraded pin must be reported explicitly; it is never silently dropped.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Write-time contradiction candidates: cosine ≥0.95 and text divergence ≥0.2 → symmetric contradicts edge + manual resolve
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Used only as a candidate generator. A hit puts both revisions into a PENDING/disputed artifact. Resolution is a supersede that propagates through the DAG; the loser is not overwritten directly.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Claim-once handoff baton (UPDATE ... WHERE state='open')
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: ctx_handoff_begin/accept. The handoff carries a certificate, which is re-validated on accept and returns any items that went stale.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Idempotent outbox with content-addressed packet ids (BEGIN IMMEDIATE, INSERT OR IGNORE, bounded retries)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: Events from hooks and host post-hooks go into the local outbox first, then the writer consumes them. Crashes and compaction do not create duplicate revisions.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: PreToolUse hook as the action gate (permissionDecision deny/allow, inject one line ≤480B)
adopted_mechanisms.from_project: volcengine/OpenViking plugin (uri-guard deny, pattern only, not code), vshulcz/deja-vu hook-tool (advisory payload size)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed (both are path routing or advisory injection; neither validates context)
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: The hook placement and output format are proven. UltraCode's PreToolUse sends {session cert, tool_name, footprint} to ctxd, which returns allow/warn/deny with a one-line WHY_NOT. By default, writes outside ctxd's scope are fail-open and policy can make them fail-closed. memory-graph explicitly forbids gating, so gating must be opt-in.

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Declared-vs-done drift (undeclared/phantom, symmetric-difference score)
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: After an action, the footprint declared in the certificate is compared with the file set actually changed in the git diff. The drift is written to an audit artifact. This is detection only and blocks nothing.

rejected_mechanisms: mem0 V3 linked_memory_ids as a supersedes signal: verified as broken twice over. The code never reads it, and the prompt asks for UUIDs while showing the model only integer ids. It cannot be treated as an existing supersession implementation.
mem0 hosted Platform MCP add/update/delete tools: README-only, no code verified.
Hindsight's 'last_recall.json re-injection after compaction': refuted. It is written but never read.
Hindsight's hard delete of observations, plus 'any one source lost means delete': conflicts with OR support counting and PENDING. Only the lock-ordering details are kept.
cognee 'improve' as an MCP tool: refuted, it is not registered in this snapshot.
cognee ProvenanceManager.invalidate / supersedes / valid_until as working invalidation: no production caller, and nothing reads those fields.
cognee skill _apply_proposal: no base-revision check and no status check. Used as a counterexample.
Dolt CommitHook as a pre-commit veto: refuted. Errors are explicitly ignored and the hook runs after the commit.
TencentDB JEV gate as a semantic validity gate: verification shows it only triggers regeneration early and never vetoes; it is also opt-in. Only its label taxonomy is borrowed.
TencentDB L1 dedup 'delete then insert, minting a new id' and the profile gateway's baseline re-read: in effect last-writer-wins and destructive supersession.
TencentDB 'memory-cleaner periodically reconciles JSONL': refuted. It only deletes by age.
mcp-memory-service belief contradiction input: dead code (storage has no .graph, and get_edges is undefined).
mcp-memory-service per-field LWW resolution with HLC for head moves: heads must use CAS. HLC events are kept only as a candidate for future cross-machine replication.
memory-graph's sqlite-backend version field / history: the version is never incremented on sqlite. Only FalkorDB has :MemoryVersion snapshots, which have no CAS.
memory-graph valid_until/invalidated_by as automatic invalidation: no code path writes them after an edge is created.

OpenViking as host or code dependency: AGPL-3.0, and replacing a memory rewrites links onto the replacement, which silently transfers trust. Only the idea of digest-based early cutoff plus a pending counter is borrowed.
Letta V1's 'truncate future history on undo' and its version column clients cannot supply: retired, and destructive.
agent-memory-mcp mtime drift scan: weak signal. Replaced by Kage-style content and symbol hashes.
agent-memory (tigerless) 'exactly-once ingestion' and 'force a successor when the fact changes': verified as at-least-once, and bypassable through memory_correct.
Graphiti MERGE + SET r = edge whole-property overwrite: the lost-update hazard.
Lease locks without fencing (OpenViking PathLock, TencentDB checkpoint): if leases are used at all, they must carry a monotonically increasing epoch checked by the store.
designs.architecture:
Process and components (single machine, co-located, as plan §2.3/B13 requires):
1. ctxd daemon, written in Rust.
   - Contains the ContextDB kernel from plan §5: revisions, heads, rules/incidences, counters, the Pearce-Kelly topological order, and the L0/L1/L2 fixpoint.
   - Writer: one writer thread (ai-memory pattern) that accepts commands over an mpsc channel and executes SD8 staged transactions. Multi-head CAS and certificate re-validation happen in the same transaction (filling Dolt's gap).
   - Readers: multiple read-only connections serve snapshot reads by epoch.
2. Storage: SQLite in WAL mode, as the system of record.
   - Tables: logical_items, revisions (append-only, body_sha256, verified_code_commit, host_ref), heads (with a unique index), rules and incidences (append-only, SD4), validation_records (keyed by RuleId+curvec), certificates, artifacts (conflict/pending/violation, after Dolt), outbox (mem0 EvidenceStore pattern), claims (token fence, after Letta), audit_log (hash chain, after cognee's PROV-O, with sequence_id+checksum).
   - Revision bodies above a threshold go into a blake3 content-addressed payload store with purge tombstones (brain0, confirmed).
   - The host's vector index is treated as a derived projection that can be rebuilt (lesson from mem0/cognee's untransacted cross-store writes).
3. Host adapters, a Rust trait with out-of-process plugins.
   - hindsight-adapter (Python): a package implementing OperationValidatorExtension that forwards post-hook events to the ctxd HTTP outbox. A reconciler periodically diffs list/get memory results against ctxd's host_ref set, catching hard deletes made by delete_stale_observations that may fire no hook.
   - mem0-adapter: a mem0-compatible API shim plus projection publishing (revision_id and validity written into the payload).
   - generic-adapter: for users with no host, it uses ctxd's own minimal FTS5 store.
4. code-pin watcher, triggered by git post-commit/post-checkout/post-merge hooks. It computes path/symbol span hashes (tree-sitter, multi-language, closing Kage's TS-only gap) or the git blob OID, and submits SetHead for code:// Evidence items.
5. Semantic validator workers: separate processes that claim (RuleId, curvec) jobs and call the LLM outside the transaction, Hindsight two-phase style. Results come back as ValidationRecord transactions.
6. MCP server (stdio + streamable HTTP) and agent hook binaries (Claude Code/Codex/Cursor: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop/SubagentStop, PreCompact). Hooks only talk to the ctxd HTTP API, at a sub-50ms target.

Language choice: Rust for the kernel, daemon, watcher and hooks, so the latency is predictable and the plan's §5 types are reused. The Hindsight adapter is Python because the host is Python. Licenses: the core is Apache-2.0 (compatible with mem0, Graphiti and cognee code borrowing; Hindsight is MIT). No GPL/AGPL code is introduced (Kage and OpenViking are reimplemented from ideas only).
designs.data_model_and_api:
Core identifiers: LogicalId (kind ∈ Fact|Derived|Decision|Evidence|Code), RevisionId (u64 + body_sha256), RuleId, Epoch (global u64), CertId (blake3 of the read-set vector).

Rule = {concl: RevisionId, incidences: [{rev, kind: Pin|Cur|Sem|Ref}], enabled}. Normalization follows SD6; there is no default edge type.
Certificate = {cert_id, principal, branch, epoch, reads: [{logical, rev, layer_status: CERTIFIED|PENDING, via_rule}], code_pins: [{path, symbol?, hash}], verified_code_commit, footprint_declared?: [paths], strict_no_aba: bool}.

MCP tools (ctx_ prefix; the read verbs are close to Hindsight/cognee, the write verbs follow ai-memory):
- ctx_recall(query, scope{repo,dir,lane}, max_tokens, mode=certified|all) → {hits:[{logical, rev, status, reasons, snippet, host_ref}], withheld:[{logical, status}], cert_id}. Proxies host recall, filters and annotates by SD13, and records the read set.
- ctx_read(logical | logical@rev, level=abstract|full) → {rev, body, status, why_summary}. Appends to the session certificate.
- ctx_put(kind, body, scope, create_only=true) → {logical, rev}
- ctx_revise(logical, body, expected_head, adopt_as_base: bool, required) → {rev} | precondition_failed{expected,current}
- ctx_justify(concl, premises:[{rev, kind}]) → {rule_id} | CycleDetected | DuplicateRule
- ctx_rebind(rule_id, from, to) / ctx_set_rule_enabled(rule_id, bool)
- ctx_validate(rule_id | revision, verdict=Verified|Rejected, curvec_seen) → ok | curvec_moved
- ctx_retract(rev)
- ctx_why(rev, layer) / ctx_why_not(rev, depth) → SD15 witness
- ctx_certify(session|reads) → certificate
- ctx_check(cert_id, action{tool, footprint}) → {decision: allow|warn|deny, stale:[{logical, old_rev, new_head, reason}], why_not}
- ctx_subscribe(logicals|scope) → event stream {changed|invalidated|pending, affected}, modeled on Letta's memory_updated
- ctx_handoff_begin(summary, cert_id) / ctx_handoff_accept(id) → {revalidation}

HTTP (for hooks): POST /v1/events (outbox, idempotency key = sha256(source‖session‖seq)), POST /v1/gate, GET /v1/session/{id}/delta.

Hook contracts:
- SessionStart: creates the session certificate and records repo HEAD/branch (mem0 RepoContext).
- UserPromptSubmit: calls /delta. If any head changed, it returns additionalContext containing a <context_update> delta (Letta).
- PreToolUse(Edit|Write|Bash|ApplyPatch): reads {session_id, tool_name, tool_input}, derives a footprint (paths/commands) and calls POST /v1/gate. It returns permissionDecision deny (with a one-line reason, ≤480B) or allow. The failure policy, fail-open or fail-closed, is configured per tool.
- PostToolUse: records the actual footprint for brain0-style drift, and asks the watcher to refresh pins.
- Stop/SubagentStop/PreCompact: flush the outbox.

Host adapter trait: ingest(HostEvent{Retained|Consolidated{obs, sources}|MentalModelRefreshed{based_on}|Updated|Invalidated|Deleted}) → Vec<Op>; resolve(host_ref) → LogicalId; recall(q) → Vec<HostHit>; reconcile(since) → Vec<HostEvent>.

Hindsight mapping:
- document/chunk → Evidence.
- world/experience fact → Fact with a Pin to the chunk.
- observation → Derived, one single-premise rule per source (OR). Edges are Sem by default, so a source edit makes the observation PENDING rather than deleted.
- mental model → Derived, one rule with Sem incidences over every based_on citation.
- invalidate_memory → RetractBase.
- An edit → a new revision plus SetHead.
designs.differentiation:
Taken together, the verified overlap verdicts say that none of the 13 analyzed projects (15+ repositories) provides:
(1) Transitive invalidation along dependencies. Hindsight goes one hop then hard-deletes; cognee deletes the cache only on hard delete; brain0's blast_radius produces only a scalar; everything else tracks no dependencies at all.
(2) AND/OR justification with support counting, where losing one alternative does not invalidate the conclusion. Hindsight's proof_count is only a rerank boost, cognee has only OR owner sets, and agent-memory's r.support is a counter that only grows.
(3) Structural validity orthogonal to a semantic PENDING state. No project has a persisted PENDING that propagates; TencentDB's JEV only triggers early, and deja-vu's stale label is set by hand.
(4) A certified read covering multiple keys plus transitively derived state, checked when the action happens. TencentDB pins only skills and never validates actions; Kage gates only at merge/PR, against the whole repository; every PreToolUse hook (OpenViking, deja-vu, letta-code) does only path routing or injection. memory-graph explicitly forbids gating.
(5) Superseding a target leaves its dependents STALE, not silently retargeted. OpenViking and ai-memory both retarget dependents onto the new head.
(6) Multi-head CAS plus certificate validation in one atomic step. Dolt has only one of the two.
(7) Code dependencies tied to per-item revisions at symbol granularity. mem0 captures git_sha but never compares; Kage compares but only for TS/JS, has no transactions, and does not propagate.

All of the above runs as a sidecar on the hosts with the most stars (Hindsight 52k, mem0 67k). Users keep their retrieval and extraction pipelines, which neither the research prototypes (PlanFence, MemTX, PACMI) nor these products offer.
mvp_scope: M0 kernel: the plan's §4 SD1-SD17 implemented in Rust (L0 support counting, the L1/L2 fixpoint, Pin-strict, Sem ValidationRecord per (RuleId,curvec)), with exact comparison against the oracle and goldens T06a-d/T15b-c/T29

ctxd: a single-writer SQLite WAL store with append-only revisions/rules, a heads unique index, expected_head CAS returning {expected,current}, multi-head atomic transactions, an outbox, and a hash-chained audit log
MCP tools: ctx_recall (certified mode, generic FTS5 backend), ctx_read, ctx_put, ctx_revise, ctx_justify, ctx_validate, ctx_retract, ctx_why/why_not, ctx_check
Claude Code hook bundle: SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit (delta injection) / PreToolUse gate (warn by default, deny optional) / PostToolUse footprint / Stop flush
code-pin watcher: git blob OID pins (whole file) plus TS/JS/Python/Rust symbol span hashes via tree-sitter; code:// Evidence head moves trigger STALE/PENDING
Hindsight adapter v0: observation source_memory_ids → OR rules, based_on → Sem rules, invalidate/edit/delete events plus a periodic reconcile; ctx_recall proxies Hindsight recall

Evaluation: a stale-action acceptance vs legitimate allow rate demo (a fact is superseded, a code file is changed, a source is retracted while alternative support remains, and the gate's decision is correct in each case), with comparison baselines of plain Hindsight and mem0
roadmap: M1 (weeks 1-6): kernel + oracle + ctxd + MCP + Claude Code hooks + git-blob pins; generic backend; publish a CLI that runs locally (`ultracode init` installs the git and agent hooks)

M2 (weeks 7-10): Hindsight adapter (OperationValidatorExtension package + reconciler), certified proxy for recall, the retracted-grounding allowlist and 'unresolvable' guard; symbol-level pins; delta message keeps the prompt cache

M3 (weeks 11-14): semantic validator workers (two-phase, token-fenced claims, JEV-style labels conflict/boundary_change/new_rule/reinforcement mapped to Verified/Rejected/keep PENDING); write-time contradiction candidates (cosine+divergence) → conflict artifacts; handoff baton with certificate
M4: mem0 adapter (API shim + projection publishing) and Codex/Cursor hook adapters; ctx_subscribe push; principal/ACL (mem0 lanes + Hindsight tag-scope hooks)
M5: branches/alternatives (Letta-style worktree staging + Dolt DiffOp merge + artifacts), BRANCH_ONLY dimension; Graphiti adapter (contradicted_facts as Sem PENDING signals)

V1: dynamic SCC (SD17 reservation), H1-H4 benchmarks (scale calibrated to MemTrace, PlanFence/MemTX suites as conformance), optional cross-machine HLC event replication (heads still CAS, via a single leader)
risks: Hindsight extension points may not fully cover hard deletes: delete_stale_observations has not been verified to fire an on_*_complete hook, so some events must come from reconcile diffs. There is an observation window, and certificates must carry the reconcile watermark to say how stale they may be.

Semantic mismatch with the host: Hindsight's 'lose any one source and delete' vs UltraCode's OR support. The ctxd revision copy and the host's live set will diverge, and users will see 'ctxd says SUPPORTED but Hindsight no longer has it'. A clear BRANCH/HOST_MISSING presentation is needed.
Hindsight evolves fast (~180k lines, 114 migrations). The adapter is tied to one extension API version, so a contract test suite is required (borrowing TencentDB's metadata-store.contract pattern).

PreToolUse latency and false blocks: a false deny on a legitimate action directly hurts agent productivity. The default is warn, deny requires opt-in, and the legitimate allow rate must be reported (plan H3).

Undeclared dependencies: agents will not consistently call ctx_justify. If read sets come only from recall/read records, transitive coverage is incomplete. Rules have to be generated from host provenance (source_memory_ids/based_on) and hooks; LLM-inferred dependencies are only ever Sem.

Code-pin noise: formatting changes break byte-level hashes (a limitation Kage admits). Structural fingerprints that ignore layout and comments are needed (agents-remember claim_reopen approach), otherwise a flood of PENDING appears.

The single-writer SQLite design is limited to one machine. Team sharing needs a central ctxd, which conflicts with the co-located assumption (plan B13, PlanFence's network penalty), so latency must be measured in emulated-link settings.
Novelty is limited: most mechanisms are prior art (plan §2.1). Product differentiation rests on combination and usability. Academic contributions are limited to the §2.2 deltas and must be measured.
Revision growth: never physically deleting means GC is needed for revisions that are neither head, nor pinned, nor referenced by a live certificate (Hindsight's storage-cost argument).
Naming: 'ultracode' does not appear in any existing document. It is taken here as the product's working name and needs user confirmation.

designs.strategy:
产品工作名：UltraCode。我把用户说的“整合ultracode”理解为：把 ContextDB 内核与按 star 数筛出、源码已验证的做法整合成一个面向编码 agent 的产品。

总体策略分五条。

1. 内核用 ContextDB 自己的语义：不可变 revision、逻辑 head 的 CAS、AND/OR justification 计数、flip-only 传播、Pin/Cur/Sem/Ref、L0/L1/L2 分层（SD1-SD17）。这些在被分析的 12 组项目里都不存在（各 overlap_verdict 一致确认），是产品的差异点，不外包给任何现有项目。

2. 内核以外的部分（存储布局、并发原语、hook 接入、检索、打包、MCP 动词、git 镜像），只采用验证结论为 confirmed 或 partially 的机制，并按 star 数和证据强度加权：
   - 高 star 项目（mem0 67k、Hindsight 52k、OpenViking 40k、cognee 33k、Graphiti 32k、Tencent 30k、Letta 25k、Dolt 25k）提供接入面和工程模式。
   - 低 star 项目（Kage/agents-remember 42、brain0 587）只在“代码锚点失效”这一项上采纳。原因是这一项被三处高 star 的旁证支撑：mem0 采集了 git_sha 但从不比较、deja-vu 有 git files-moved 检查、Letta 用 HEAD-pinned prompt。同时在 roadmap 中把它列为需要 benchmark 证明的部分。

3. 以编码工作流为原生场景：决策、约定、计划都锚定到代码（文件、symbol 的 span hash、git blob OID、commit、测试运行结果）。代码变化本身就是 head 移动，走同一个传播内核：
   - span 内容未变：no-op。
   - 锚点仍能唯一解析但内容变了：Sem，结果为 PENDING。
   - 锚点消失或有歧义：结构失效，结果为 STALE。
   这样“代码改了”与“决策被 supersede”是同一种事件。

4. 存储采用“SQLite 为真相，git 为镜像和分支底座”。权威状态（revision、head、规则、计数器、证书）放在单 writer 的 SQLite WAL 里，因为 per-item CAS 和精确计数需要事务；Letta 的 whole-repo SHA 粒度太粗，这一点已经验证。git 用三处：每个 epoch 导出为 refs/ultracode/<branch> 上的一个 commit，带 Code-Commit trailer 和逐条 markdown；ContextDB 的分支跟随代码分支，在代码 merge 时 ratify；人类 review 和 PR diff 也在 git 上做。

5. 门控走 agent hook（PreToolUse、Stop、CI `uc check` 的退出码）。默认是 warn，enforce 需要显式 opt-in。依据是 memory-graph 刻意采用 observe-only，ai-memory 的 admission 默认 fail-open，可见主流项目回避硬门控，产品要允许渐进采纳。
designs.pitch:
UltraCode 是给多个编码 agent 共用的“带失效证明的上下文库”。agent 读到的每条决策、约定和计划都带着 revision 和代码锚点，例如 `src/auth.ts#verifyToken` 的 span hash 和 commit。下面任一情况发生，依赖它的所有派生结论都会沿 justification 图被标记：
- 另一个 agent supersede 了这条决策；
- 代码改了它引用的函数；
- 它依赖的测试证据失效。

标记分两档：语义需复核的标为 PENDING，结构上已经断裂的标为 STALE。只要还有别的支持路径（OR alternative）在，结论就不会被误杀。agent 想执行 Edit、Bash 或 git push 时，PreToolUse hook 会拿它这一轮的读证书与当前 head 和代码比对，过期就 warn 或 deny，并在 prompt 末尾追加一段 `<context_update>` 增量，不重写前缀，所以 prompt cache 不受影响。

它对外仍然是大家熟悉的 recall / read / record / supersede 几个 MCP 动词，hook 和 lane 的布局沿用 mem0、Letta、OpenViking 的做法。区别在于：其他系统只能告诉你“记得什么”，UltraCode 还能证明“这些现在仍然成立”。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 作用域 lane（shared repo lane / personal lane / ancestor-dir 标签 / 拒绝 wildcard 身份）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（注意：dir scope 只收窄 shared lane）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 每条 logical 带 (repo_id, dirs[] 祖先链, user, session, agent) 属性。recall 的过滤为 OR(shared AND repo, mine AND user)，dir 过滤同时作用于两条 lane，修掉 mem0 只收窄 shared 的缺口。拒绝 '*' 身份。它同时是 SD13 Authorized(principal, r) 的第一层。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 本地 outbox 与内容寻址的幂等 flush 包（BEGIN IMMEDIATE、packet_id=sha256(repo,session,range)、INSERT OR IGNORE、有界重试转 gave-up、崩溃恢复）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: uc-hook 不直接写 daemon，先把事件写进每个会话的本地 SQLite outbox，再按内容寻址的包投递到内核。内核把 packet_id 当作事务的幂等键，这样 PreCompact/Stop 之后重试、或 daemon 重启，都不会产生重复 revision。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 编码会话的 provenance 采集（规范化 git remote、branch、head_sha，每会话固定）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（mem0 只采集不校验，数据进 Platform 路径）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 采集方式照搬，补上 mem0 缺的校验：会话起点的 head_sha 写进证书的 code_commit，每条 revision 带 Code-Commit。代码锚点的变化会推动锚点 logical 的 head 移动，再由内核传播。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 每会话注入台账（记录注入了哪些条目、unseen 过滤、向 subagent 重放）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（缺陷：只存 id 和 text，INSERT OR IGNORE 会保留旧文本）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 升级为读证书的 read-set：记录 (logical, rev, layer_status, epoch)，同一 logical 读到新 rev 时追加，不覆盖。unseen 改为“新 rev 或状态翻转才再注入”。SubagentStart 时把父会话的证书条目作为子证书的初始集合。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 混合检索打分（semantic + 按查询长度自适应的 BM25 + entity boost）及 RRF k=60 融合
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（两者都是）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 放在派生的检索投影里，可重建，不是真相。默认只返回 head 且 L2/CERTIFIED 的条目，PENDING 和 STALE 带标注单独列出（withheld 列表）。改进了 Graphiti/mem0 那种不过滤 superseded 的做法。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 两阶段编辑：LLM/embedding 工作在连接外 prepare，短事务内重读并验证（OCC），commit 前 source 有改动就丢弃整批
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（API 层 last-writer-wins，内部 consolidation 有 updated_at 读验证和文本 CAS，#4831）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 语义复核器、合并器、摘要器的通用模式：在内核外 prepare，提交时带 expected_heads 和读到的 curvec。内核在单 writer 事务内做 CAS，失败返回 ConcurrentHead，由调用方重新 prepare。与 SD8 的批语义一致。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: stale 清扫的锁顺序（所有触及 id 排序后一次性加锁，变更前后各扫一次）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 语义只取工程部分。UltraCode 不像 Hindsight 那样硬删派生项，而是 flip 到 PENDING/STALE。将来 M4 引入 Postgres 多 writer 时，按 RevisionId 排序加锁的做法照搬。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: retracted-grounding 的三条防护：引用类型 allowlist、引用全部缺失时视为 provenance 断裂（unresolvable）而非撤回、skip_if_in_flight 合并刷新
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: (1) 只有 Decision/Fact/Evidence 类可以作 premise，Ref 不参与。(2) 导入或迁移后 premise 全部解析失败的规则标为 ImportBroken，进 artifact 队列，不级联成 STALE。(3) 后台复核任务按 (rule, curvec) 去重合并。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: accept / reject / accept_with(enrichment) 的校验 hook 形状，precheck 在解析之前
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: uc_check 和 PreToolUse 的返回采用同样的三态：allow、deny(reason)、allow_with(additionalContext=<context_update>)。服务端可插拔 policy 扩展也用这个接口。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: git 式 ref CAS：内容寻址的不可变对象，RefStore::cas_update(expected, new)，expected=None 表示仅创建，冲突返回 ConcurrentCommit 不自动重试，restore 先换 ref 再写副作用
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（机制确认；路径锁在 Python 层，不在 Rust commit_impl）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: SetHead(logical, expected, new) 的语义照搬：create_only 对应 expected=None，失败时返回 {expected, actual}。git 镜像导出也遵守“先 CAS 内核 head，后写 refs/ultracode 与 markdown”。项目是 AGPL，只重新实现思路，不复制代码。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 上行刷新：digest 早停、pending 计数器、按比例阈值决定 MARK_PENDING 还是 REFRESH_NOW
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 用于派生的摘要类产物（目录或模块级 overview、briefing）。内容 digest 不变就不向上传播，等同 flip-only。LLM 生成的摘要先标 PENDING 不立即重算，到比例阈值或被读取时再刷新。和 OpenViking 不同的是，PENDING 状态在读取结果里可见。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: Exact/Tree 层级租约、交接给 async worker（handoff/adopt）、陈旧 token 用 compare-and-write 接管
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（已确认没有 fencing）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 只用于后台工作分配，例如代码锚点重算、语义复核 worker。正确性由内核的 head CAS 保证。租约带单调 epoch 作 fencing token，内核拒绝 epoch 过期的提交，补上 OpenViking 和 Tencent 都缺的 fencing。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 按 token 预算的分层打包（L0 abstract、L1 overview、L2 body，按类型配额降级）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（两者都是）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: uc_recall 先返回 handle + abstract + status，uc_read 再按 level 展开。每次展开都记进读证书，Letta 在这里没有记录。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 读集记录与不动点传播（问答轮次记录所用元素，删除时沿 turn→feedback→lesson 传播到不动点）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（只在硬删除时触发，而且是删除，不是标 stale）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 证明了“记录读集再传递失效”在实践中确实需要（COG-5835：回答引用了已删除的事实）。UltraCode 把它泛化：触发条件覆盖 supersede、代码变化、证据撤回，结果改为标 PENDING/STALE 并保留，传播走内核计数，不做线性扫描。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 引用计数的多 owner 归属，最后一个 owner 离开时才删除，删除顺序为 vectors 优先、各步幂等
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（key 格式为 source_ref:v1/v2；第 3 步只剥离 surviving 项的 ref；原子 stamping 只在 Kuzu 验证过）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 它验证了 OR-only 的支持计数在生产中可行，UltraCode 用 SD3 的 AND/OR 计数取代它。派生检索投影的清理沿用“先删派生索引、再改真相、各步幂等可重试”。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 异步语义校验器先写标记、最后清标记，用于崩溃自修复；不变量破坏时 fail-closed 全量重建
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（review_pending 先置后清已确认；日期矛盾时降级为 conflicting，不拒绝）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: ValidationRecord 写入前先置 validating 标记，崩溃后可被发现并重做。内核启动时用 oracle 校验计数器 digest，不一致就 fail-closed，从 revision log 重建。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: LLM 矛盾判定加确定性区间规则（区间不重叠则跳过，valid_at 较晚者胜）；episode 来源列表的 OR 支持
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（缺陷：任一边缺 valid_at 时静默忽略；exact-text 快路径会跳过矛盾检查）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 把 LLM 的 contradicted_facts 当作 Sem 复核的候选生成器：命中时对双方提交 Pending，或为 CONFLICTED（SD17）artifact 建记录，不直接判 FALSE。invalidated_by 持久化为规则（Graphiti 只在内存里算，从不落盘），所以撤回 invalidator 后旧事实能自动恢复。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: MCP 记忆动词（add_memory / search_memory_facts / get_episodes）与 retain/recall/reflect 交互形状
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（cognee 的 improve 工具并未注册，按已驳斥处理，不采用）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: UltraCode 的 MCP 动词刻意保持熟悉（recall、read、record、supersede），在此基础上加 expected_head、读证书返回值和 uc_check，降低迁移成本。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 每 (id, version) 一行不可变快照，is_head 列加部分唯一索引，内容 hash 相同即为 no-op，blob 目录 copy-on-write
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（Tencent：delete 实为物理删除，Mongo appendVersion 存在静默丢写）；ai-memory：confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: SQLite 表 revisions 和 heads 使用 `UNIQUE(logical) WHERE is_head`，内容 blake3 相同时返回已有 rev。只实现 SQLite 单 writer 路径，不提供 Mongo 式“先插入再翻转”的非原子写法。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: expected_version / expected_page_id / create_only 乐观锁，失败返回 precondition_failed{expected, current}
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（ai-memory 在同一事务内比较；Tencent 是事务前 check-then-act，靠唯一约束兜底）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 所有 agent 写入都必须带 expected_head 或 create_only，这是强制的（ai-memory 是可选的）。比较放在单 writer 事务内（UPDATE heads ... WHERE head_rev=?），不采用 Tencent 的 TOCTOU 写法。错误结构照搬 ai-memory。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 会话级的懒版本钉住（首读即钉，读时注入 version=pinned，写时注入 expected_version=pinned，写成功后把钉移到新版本）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（只覆盖 skill；COS-KV 后端的钉住不过期；未配置存储时不钉住）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 泛化为读证书：一个会话读过的 (logical, rev) 集合就是 certificate，写入时自动把对应 head 作为 expected_head 注入，行动时校验。和 Tencent 不同，过期时会推送 <context_update>，不是等写失败才发现。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 生成日志：input_refs → output_refs，加 prompt_sha256 和 model
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（只写不读的审计）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 每条由 LLM 派生的 revision，其规则的 premise 就是 input_refs，变成可反查、可传播的 justification。prompt_sha256 和 model 存进规则 metadata，用于复现，并在 prompt 升级时批量标 PENDING。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 变更影响的 LLM 分类标签（conflict > boundary_change > new_rule > reinforcement > none），失败时不推进 checkpoint
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（需 opt-in；只用于提前触发，不能否决）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 作为 Sem 复核器的输出词表：reinforcement 和 none 记为 Verified，conflict 记为 Rejected，boundary_change 和 new_rule 保持 Pending 并转人工。分类器失败时不写 ValidationRecord，保持 PENDING。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: git commit 作为不可变 revision；编译上下文钉在 HEAD SHA，HEAD 变化时追加 <memory_update> 增量消息，不重写系统前缀，以保住 prompt cache
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（commit）/ partially（HEAD-pinned 编译只在 LocalBackend 中）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: git 镜像：每个内核 epoch 导出一个 commit。UserPromptSubmit 时如果证书里有条目翻转，只追加 <context_update rev=… epoch=…>，写明哪些条目失效、谁替代了它们，不重编系统 prompt。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 后台写者用隔离的 worktree 分支，merge 回来时返回类型化结果（no_changes / dirty / failed / parent_dirty / merge_conflict / merged），冲突时 abort 并保留分支
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（memory-worker 路径比 reflection 弱：不检查父 dirty，也不刷新 origin）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 后台的 consolidation 或复核 agent 在 ContextDB 分支（M2 BranchId）上写，合并时按 per-item 三方合并，并用读集验证代替 git 行级 diff。合并结果沿用 Letta 的枚举，每种结果都走完整校验路径。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 状态签名键控、带 token 栅栏的修复尝试记录（done 返回 attempted，持有者存活返回 in_progress，迟到的 worker 无法覆盖新 claim）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（单槽位）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 后台复核任务按 (rule, curvec) 签名去重，扩展为多槽位表。同一 PENDING 状态不会每轮都调用 LLM 复核。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: pid + 进程启动时间作栅栏的 O_EXCL（link()）租约，只回收确认已死的持有者
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（post-turn sync 拿不到锁就跳过，不等待）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: daemon 单实例锁和 WAL owner 锁，配合 agents-remember 的 flock 能力探测，拒绝在 NFS/SMB/WSL 上运行。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: commit 时的声明式策略闸门（read_only 字段受保护、只读 glob、大小和深度预算）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（客户端 hook 可用 --no-verify 绕过）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 策略放在内核事务的校验阶段执行，不能绕过。.ultracode/policy.toml 声明受保护的 logical、只读规则，以及哪些 kind 必须带代码锚点。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: PreToolUse hook 可以 block 或改写输入，以及按路径和身份的跨 agent 守卫
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（deja-vu 只做建议，不阻断；OpenViking 对 shell 只提示，不 deny）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 行动时门控的落点：uc-hook PreToolUse 解析 tool_input 里的路径和命令，找到当前会话的证书并校验，返回 allow、deny 或 ask，附带不超过 480 字节的理由（采用 deja-vu 的小载荷经验）。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: affected_paths 变更推送与指定时间点读取（path@SHA）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: uc_subscribe(handles) 推送 {logical, old_rev, new_rev, status_change, epoch}。read(logical@rev) 和 as_of epoch 支持历史读和证书复核。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 多数据集原子 CAS，带 ExpectedHead/NotEqual 前置条件，每次重试时重新检查；commit 时 merge，有界重试
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（函数型 Precondition 只有单数据集 SetHead 有；transaction 之间 merge 产生的冲突一律回滚）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: UltraCode 的提交把两者合在一起：同一事务内多个 SetHead(expected)，加上证书 read-set 的前置条件函数，在单 writer 内一起校验。这是 Dolt 没有提供的组合，也正是 SD8 和 certificate 需要的。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: DiffOp 分类（单边、convergent、divergent-resolved、divergent-conflict、delete-conflict），逐字段三方合并，可插拔 RowMergePolicy
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: M2 合并 agent 分支时直接复用：按 logical 比较 head 链与 merge-base，逐字段三方合并。证据列表这类集合字段用 CRDT 式 policy。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 冲突和约束违反作为版本化 artifact 持久化，存在时阻止 commit
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: CONFLICTED（SD17）、ImportBroken、未解决的合并冲突、未完成的复核，都按 (item, rev, type) 存进 artifacts 表。enforce 模式下 uc check 和 merge ratify 在有阻塞 artifact 时拒绝。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 每个 path 恰好一个 is_latest（部分唯一索引）、supersedes 链、未改动时只记 evidence 的 no-op、写入 tombstone 路径时重新接回旧链
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: heads 和 revisions 的物理布局。区别是 head 按 LogicalId 键控，不按文件路径。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 单 writer 的 actor 线程（mpsc 进、oneshot 回）加读连接分离，以及 per-path mutex
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（修正：页面写入拿共享锁加 per-path mutex，独占锁只用于 move/delete/purge）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: ucd 的 commit 线程独占 writer 连接，与 IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN 6.1 的单 writer 一致，构造上就不会出现 SQLITE_BUSY。读走快照连接。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: claim-once 交接 baton（UPDATE … WHERE state='open'，再校验接收方）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: uc_handoff_begin 把发起方的证书附到 handoff 上。uc_handoff_accept 先用 CAS 认领，再校验证书：失效条目以 <context_update> 的形式交给接收方，不会让过期计划悄悄交接出去。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 在每条退休路径上关闭 as_of 窗口，并分块回填
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 按 SD16 只建模 transaction time。head 历史表中每次 SetHead、RetractBase、tombstone 都在同一事务里关闭窗口，as_of(epoch) 读取依赖它。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: evidence 表与防固化的置信度（按不同 session 计数、上限 0.95、近因下限、1/(1+矛盾数)、supersede 永远优先）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（非 session 证据每行 0.2，总计封顶 1.0）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 只作为检索排序信号。有效性完全由 L0/L1/L2 决定，置信度永远不能把 STALE 抬回去。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 写入时的矛盾候选（top-5 最近邻，cosine ≥ 0.95 且文本差异 ≥ 0.20），以及 superseded_by IS NULL 守护的 supersede UPDATE
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 廉价的语义冲突候选生成器：命中时写一条 contradicts 的 Ref 边，并把双方相关规则的复核请求置为 Pending，不判 FALSE。“仍是 head”的守护由内核 CAS 统一承担。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: admission webhook 链（200 改写、204 放行、4xx/5xx 按 FailurePolicy 处理；带防环 header）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed（默认 Ignore，即 fail-open；可设为非阻塞）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 作为企业侧的扩展点：写入和行动校验都可以挂外部 policy webhook。每个 hook 单独配置 fail-open 或 fail-closed。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: git 的“files moved since”陈旧检查（mtime 预过滤，每个 repo 一次 git log --since，有时间预算，只断言“已变化”、从不断言“未变化”）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 代码锚点的快速路径和诚实性原则：报告“已变化”是确定的，没有信号就算 UNKNOWN，严格读时映射为 PENDING（SD14）。未提交的改动由 working-tree 扫描补齐。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 写入准入规则：valid_from 不得晚于所引证据的时间；LLM 只能引用读表（sheet）上给出的 handle；证据中不存在的地址拒绝写入
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: uc_record 的 deps 只能引用本会话读证书里出现过的 handle，或显式给出的 logical@rev，防止 agent 编造依赖和记忆投毒。证据型 premise 的时间必须早于结论的创建时间。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 事实变化时强制写 successor，只有描述类元数据可以原地改
adopted_mechanisms.verified: partially（memory_correct 可以绕过）
adopted_mechanisms.how_used: 放在内核里，对所有路径强制：body 一旦变化，必须 AddRevision 加 SetHead，修补 agent-memory 的绕过漏洞。

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 内容 hash 的幂等 revision id、blake3 内容寻址的 payload 库与 crypto-shred tombstone
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed

adopted_mechanisms.mechanism: 声明 vs 实际漂移（undeclared = actual − declared，phantom = declared − actual）
adopted_mechanisms.verified: confirmed

designs.architecture:
进程模型：co-located，每个 repo 一个 daemon。这是对 B13 和 PlanFence 结论的约束：认证延迟必须在本机完成。

1) `ucd` daemon，用 Rust 实现，复用计划 §5 的 workspace：contextdb-model、contextdb-core、contextdb-oracle。
   - commit actor 线程独占 SQLite writer 连接，WAL，busy_timeout，采用 ai-memory 的单 writer actor 模式。读请求走 snapshot 连接池。
   - 内核在内存里保留 compact CSR 计数结构（SD3 的 sat 位、unsat、support_count，以及 Pearce-Kelly rank），启动时从 SQLite 重建，再用 oracle 校验 digest，不一致就 fail-closed。
   - daemon 单实例锁用 pid+starttime 的 link() 租约，并做 flock 能力探测，拒绝网络文件系统。
   - 后台任务有四类：(a) 代码锚点扫描器，(b) 语义复核队列（按 (rule, curvec) 签名的 fenced claim），(c) 检索投影构建器，(d) git 镜像导出器。它们都通过“连接外 prepare，再 CAS 提交”与内核交互，租约带 epoch fencing。

2) 存储。
   - `.ultracode/db.sqlite` 是真相源。表：logicals、revisions（不可变）、heads（加 head_history 的窗口）、rules、incidences、base_bits、validation_records、certificates、cert_entries、artifacts、evidence、audit_log、outbox_ack。
   - `.ultracode/blobs/` 是 blake3 内容寻址的 payload，支持 shred。
   - 检索投影：SQLite FTS5 加可选的 sqlite-vec，可以 `uc reindex` 重建。
   - git 镜像：`refs/ultracode/<branch>`，每个 epoch 一个 commit，每个 logical 一个 markdown 文件，YAML frontmatter 包含 rev、status、deps、anchors，trailer 写 Code-Commit 和 UC-Epoch，供 PR 审阅和备份。镜像可以从 db 重建，但 db 不从镜像恢复。M4 再支持从镜像冷启动。

3) 代码锚点子系统。
   - 用 tree-sitter 解析，支持 TS、JS、Py、Go、Rust、Java，抽出 symbol span，计算 hash。整文件 hash 用 git blob OID 快速路径。
   - 触发源有四个：git post-commit、post-checkout、post-merge hook；文件系统 watcher（带 debounce）；PostToolUse(Edit/Write) hook；会话开始时的 git log --since 预扫描。
   - 锚点模型：logical `code:<repo>/<path>#<symbol>` 的 revision 等于 span hash，head 等于工作树当前值。span 变化时提交 SetHead。锚点消失或解析出歧义时，对当前 rev 执行 RetractBase，并写一条 artifact。
   - 测试结果作为 Evidence 类 logical，单 revision，记录 commit 和命令。
   - 内核传播自动区分三种结果：Sem 记为 PENDING，Cur 或 Pin 记为 STALE，Unsupported 记为 STALE。

4) 接入层。
   - `uc-hook` 是静态二进制，供 Claude Code 和 Codex 的 hooks.json 调用，并自带一个本地 outbox（SQLite）。
   - `uc-mcp` 是 stdio MCP server，作为 ucd 的薄客户端。
   - `uc` CLI 包括 check、why、why-not、log、reindex、export、doctor。
   - git hooks 包括 post-commit、post-checkout、post-merge（同步锚点并 ratify 分支）和 pre-push（`uc check`）。CI 用 `uc check --strict` 的退出码。
   - 可选的 webhook policy 链。

5) 语言与技术选择。
   - 内核用 Rust，要的是计数和 layout 的常数因子（H1）。
   - SQLite 适合单机和 agent 规模；M4 才考虑 Postgres，届时采用 Hindsight 的排序加锁和 SKIP LOCKED 队列。
   - 代码锚点用 tree-sitter。
   - LLM 不进内核：复核器和矛盾候选生成器是外部 worker，复用 host CLI 或 API，提交 ValidationRecord。这与 tigerless 的“内核不带 LLM 客户端”一致。
designs.data_model_and_api:
内核 Op（单事务按顺序执行，见 SD8）：
- `AddRevision{logical, kind(Decision|Fact|Plan|Convention|Evidence|CodeAnchor|Summary), body_ref(blake3), meta, code_commit}`，按内容去重：blake3 相同时返回已存在的 rev。
- `SetHead{logical, expected: Option<Rev>, new}`：CAS，expected=None 表示 create_only。
- `AssertBase{rev}` / `RetractBase{rev}`
- `AddRule{concl, incidences:[{rev, kind: Pin|Cur|Sem|Ref}], meta{source: agent|llm_derivation{prompt_sha256, model}|import, created_by}}`：不设默认 kind，规范化规则见 SD6。
- `SetRuleEnabled{rule, bool}` / `Rebind{rule, from, to}`
- `AddValidationRecord{rule, curvec, verdict: Verified|Rejected, label?(reinforcement|none|conflict|boundary_change|new_rule), evidence_rev?}`
- `IssueCert{session, branch, entries}` / `RecordArtifact{item, rev, type}`
- 事务前置条件：`expect_heads[]`，以及 `expect_cert_valid{cert_id}`，在同一个 writer 事务内校验。
- 错误类型：`PreconditionFailed{logical, expected, current}`、`CycleDetected{op_index, path}`、`DuplicateRule{existing, enabled}`、`PolicyViolation{rule}`、`FencedOut{lease_epoch}`。

状态（SD13 汇总，逐维度给出）：
`Status{summary: UNAVAILABLE|CONFLICTED|STALE{reason}|PENDING|CERTIFIED, l0, l1, l2, sem, currency: CURRENT|SUPERSEDED|BRANCH_ONLY, witness}`

证书：
`Certificate{cert_id, session_id, principal, branch, issued_epoch, code_commit, worktree_digest, entries:[{logical, rev, required: Certified|AtLeastL1, via: Head|Alternative}], strict_no_aba:false, scope_paths[]}`
- 校验结果为 `Valid | ValidViaAlternative | Invalid{diffs:[{logical, old_rev, new_rev?, new_status, reason}]}`。
- 每条读取都追加到当前会话证书，并以 copy-on-write 方式生成新的 cert_id。

MCP 工具（stdio）：
- `uc_recall(query, scope?{lanes, dirs, kinds}, budget_tokens?, mode: certified|advisory)` 返回 `{items:[{handle, logical, rev, kind, status, abstract, anchors}], withheld:[{handle, status, reason}], cert_id}`
- `uc_read(handle | logical@rev, level: abstract|outline|full)` 返回 body 和 status，并记入证书。
- `uc_record(kind, body, anchors?:[{path, symbol?, range?}], deps?:[{target: handle|logical@rev|anchor, kind}], expected_head? | create_only?, adopt_as_base: bool)`
  - deps 只能引用本会话证书中的 handle 或显式的 logical@rev。
  - anchors 自动展开为 CodeAnchor revision 和对应 incidence，默认 kind=Sem；写 `strict:true` 时为 Cur。
- `uc_supersede(logical, body, expected_head, carry_rules: rebind|none, reason)`
- `uc_validate(rule | rev, verdict, label?, evidence?)`
- `uc_why(rev)` / `uc_why_not(rev)`：按 SD15，WHY_NOT 列出 disabled、gate、各个失败的 incidence。
- `uc_check(cert_id? , action?{tool, paths, command})` 返回 `{decision: allow|warn|deny, diffs, context_update}`
- `uc_handoff_begin(summary, next_steps, cert_id)` / `uc_handoff_accept(handoff_id)` 返回接收方证书和失效差异。
- `uc_subscribe(handles)`，流式推送 `{logical, old_rev, new_rev, status_change, epoch}`。
- `uc_history(logical)` / `uc_as_of(query, epoch)`

Hook 契约（uc-hook 从 stdin 读 JSON，向 stdout 写 JSON；daemon 不可达时按 policy 处理，默认 fail-open 并给出 warn）：
- SessionStart：固定 repo/branch/head_sha；新建会话证书（code_commit 取当前 HEAD）；注入 briefing，内容是 CERTIFIED 的约定和决策，加上 PENDING 和 STALE 的摘要。
- UserPromptSubmit：先确认证书条目是否翻转，有翻转就把 `<context_update epoch=… >失效项/替代者</context_update>` 作为 additionalContext 追加，不重写系统前缀；再按需 recall 注入，结果写进证书。
- PreToolUse(Edit|Write|ApplyPatch|Bash|git push)：
  - 输入 {session_id, tool_name, tool_input}。
  - 解析出目标路径，找出锚定这些路径、且在证书里的决策；
  - 再调用 `uc_check`。
  - 输出 `{permissionDecision: allow|deny|ask, reason≤480B, additionalContext}`。默认 warn，enforce 模式下凡是触碰 STALE 决策或 CONFLICTED artifact 的路径一律 deny。
- PostToolUse(Edit|Write)：把触碰到的文件入队做锚点重算；记录实际写集合。
- PostToolUseFailure：记录为 Evidence。
- SubagentStart：子会话证书继承父会话的条目。SubagentStop：把子证书并入父证书。
- Stop / PreCompact / SessionEnd：通过 outbox 冲刷 packet_id=sha256(repo, session, event_range)；计算声明与实际的漂移；视情况自动发起 handoff。

git hook：
- post-commit / post-checkout：同步锚点 head。
- post-merge：用一个原子事务 ratify 分支并合并到 main，冲突写成 artifact。
- pre-push 和 CI：`uc check --strict --range origin/main..HEAD`，PR 触及的锚点所关联的决策只要是 STALE 或 CONFLICTED，退出码就非 0。
designs.differentiation:
以下各点都以 overlap_verdict 已确认的“缺失”为依据，对比的是 12 组项目中相关的那几个。

1) 传递失效。被分析的项目都没有沿依赖图做传递失效：
   - Hindsight 只有 fact 到 observation 的一跳，而且是硬删除。
   - cognee 的不动点只在硬删除时作用于 session 缓存，而且也是删除。
   - Graphiti 只把被矛盾的那条边设为过期。
   - Kage 和 agents-remember 对每条记忆单独比对代码，不传播。
   - brain0 的 blast_radius 做了 BFS，但只产出一个风险标量。
   UltraCode 用 flip-only 计数，在整个 justification DAG 上传播。

2) OR 替代支持。没有任何项目在“支持来源有多条”时保留结论：
   - Hindsight 丢失任意一个 source 就删 observation。
   - cognee 和 Graphiti 只有 OR 型的 owner 或 episode 集合，没有 AND/OR 规则。
   - agent-memory 的 r.support 只增不减，删除消息也不会减少它。
   UltraCode 按 SD3 计数，并支持 CurrentViaAlternative。在有替代路径时，证书不会逼迫 agent 重新规划。

3) 结构失效与语义 PENDING 正交。现有项目要么只有两态（tigerless 明确拒绝第三态），要么只有单一格（deja 的 stale 是人工标注，Tencent 的 JEV 只用于提前触发重生成）。UltraCode 可以表达 `CURRENT+SUPPORTED+PENDING`、`STALE(SupersededPinnedPremise)` 这类组合状态。

4) 代码变化与决策变化走同一个内核：
   - mem0 采集了 git_sha，但从不比较。
   - Kage 和 agents-remember 能判断单条记忆过期，但不会传播到建立在它上面的计划或约定。
   - deja-vu 只给建议性标注。
   UltraCode 把代码锚点建模为 head 会移动的 logical，代码变化同样沿依赖链传播，并且按三分类精确区分 PENDING 与 STALE。

5) 行动时证书校验。现有最接近的做法覆盖面都不够：
   - Tencent 只钉住 skill 版本，而且只拦截写入。
   - Letta 只在下一轮开始时比较整个 repo 的 HEAD。
   - Dolt 有多 head 的 CAS，也有前置条件函数，但两者不能组合使用。
   - Kage 只在 merge 或 PR 时检查。
   - mem0、Hindsight、Graphiti、cognee 都没有 PreToolUse 门控。
   UltraCode 把单快照、多 key、覆盖传递派生状态的读证书，挂在每一次工具调用上校验，并且在同一个事务里同时检查多个 head 的 CAS 和读集前置条件。

6) agent API 强制 expected_head。所有项目对 agent 暴露的都是可选的 per-key CAS，或者干脆是 last-writer-wins。UltraCode 强制要求 expected_head，并把它与“依赖只能引用证书里的 handle”这条准入规则绑定在一起。
mvp_scope: M0+M1a 内核（计划 §8）：SQLite 单 writer actor、不可变 revision 与部分唯一索引的 head、SetHead CAS（create_only/expected）、AND/OR 计数加 flip-only 传播、Pin/Cur/Sem/Ref、SD10 ValidationRecord、L0/L1/L2 与 SD13 汇总、WHY/WHY_NOT；oracle 每个 epoch 精确比对计数器

代码锚点 v1：用 tree-sitter 支持 TS/JS/Python/Go/Rust 的 symbol span hash，git blob OID 快速路径；触发源为 post-commit/checkout/merge、PostToolUse(Edit/Write) 和会话开始时预扫描；三分类映射到 no-op、Sem PENDING、STALE；测试运行记为 Evidence revision
会话读证书：recall/read 自动记录 (logical, rev, status)，并带 code_commit；`uc_check` 返回 Valid/ValidViaAlternative/Invalid{diffs}；事务支持 expect_cert_valid 前置条件

Claude Code 和 Codex 的 hook 包：SessionStart briefing、UserPromptSubmit 的 <context_update> 增量注入（不重写前缀）、PreToolUse 的 warn 模式（enforce 需 opt-in）、PostToolUse 锚点入队、Stop/PreCompact 通过本地 outbox 幂等冲刷、SubagentStart/Stop 的证书继承
MCP stdio 工具：uc_recall、uc_read、uc_record（强制 expected_head/create_only，deps 只能引用证书内 handle）、uc_supersede、uc_validate、uc_why、uc_why_not、uc_check、uc_handoff_begin/accept
lane 与权限：repo/dir/user/session/agent 作用域，拒绝 wildcard；Authorized 只实现 lane 级
检索投影：FTS5 加 BM25（向量可选），默认只返回 CERTIFIED head，其余进 withheld 列表；分层打包 abstract→outline→full
CLI 与 CI：`uc check --strict` 的退出码门控（pre-push/CI）、`uc why`、`uc log`、`uc doctor`（含 flock 能力探测）、`uc reindex`
git 镜像导出（只读）：refs/ultracode/main，逐 logical 一个 markdown，带 Code-Commit/UC-Epoch trailer，供 PR 审阅
语义复核 worker（外部进程）：LLM 判定使用 JEV 标签词表，按 (rule, curvec) 做 fenced claim 去重，结果写回 ValidationRecord；矛盾候选用 cosine≥0.95 加文本差异≥0.2，结果设为 PENDING
roadmap: M1b/M1.5：baseline 与实验 harness，按计划 §9 对比 RevokeAll（MemTX 式）、TypedMaxLattice（PACMI 式）、NaiveBfs、DD；新增“代码锚点失效” workload，用真实 repo 的 commit 历史回放，测 false invalidation 和避免的 LLM 复核次数（H2a），以此证明低 star 的 Kage/agents-remember 机制在规模上成立
M2 分支与合并：ContextDB BranchId 跟随 git 分支；post-merge 原子 ratify；采用 Dolt DiffOp 分类加逐字段三方合并与 RowMergePolicy；后台 agent 在隔离分支上写，合并结果按 Letta 枚举返回；CONFLICTED/阻塞 artifact 阻止 merge
M3 证书强化：PreToolUse enforce 模式 GA；strict_no_aba；Ed25519 in-toto 签名证书（brain0 式），下游 CI 可离线验证 action 当时依据的上下文；acknowledged 证书交接
订阅与推送：uc_subscribe 变更流加 websocket；在多 agent 同时运行时主动推送 <context_update>，不再等下一轮

生态 adapter：mem0 兼容 API 垫片（add/search/get/update/history 映射到 revision 链）；Hindsight 与 Graphiti 导入器（source_memory_ids、based_on、contradicted_facts 转为规则或 PENDING）；Kage packet 与 agents-remember 台账导入；deja-vu transcript 作为 Evidence 来源
M4 持久化与多机：Postgres 后端（排序加锁、SKIP LOCKED 队列）；HLC 幂等事件复制（mcp-memory-service 式，修掉 NULL agent 的 UNIQUE 漏洞），head 移动仍走 CAS 或 alternative；可从 git 镜像冷启动
可选 valid-time 元数据（Graphiti 式），不进入有效性语义，作为 SD16 的非目标扩展
V1：动态 SCC 下的计数器重分类（SD17 预留位）；派生 head 的客户端 auto-promote 事务
risks: 新颖性风险：计划 §2.1 已经列明 Counting、TMS、PlanFence、MemTX、Graphiti、Letta 都是 prior art。产品宣传必须限定在 §2.2 的 delta 和“代码锚点与决策走同一内核”的工程整合上，并用 baseline 实测支撑，不能声称概念首创
代码锚点误报和漏报：byte 级 span hash 会把纯格式化改动判为变化（Kage 的已知局限）；按名字匹配锚点是启发式的；tree-sitter 多语言质量不一。缓解：结构化指纹（agents-remember 式，忽略注释和布局），未提交改动单独扫描，保持“已变化确定、无信号即 UNKNOWN”的不对称诚实原则
低 star 证据风险：symbol 锚定和 claim 三分类只来自约 42 star 的项目，没有大规模实战数据。虽有 mem0、deja-vu、Letta 的旁证，仍需 M1b 的回放 benchmark 证明 false invalidation 可接受
采纳阻力：主流记忆项目刻意不做门控（memory-graph observe-only，ai-memory 默认 fail-open）。PreToolUse 的 deny 可能打断 agent 工作流，所以默认 warn，enforce 逐 repo opt-in，并度量合法行动的放行率（H3）
agent 不声明依赖：如果 agent 写 uc_record 时不给 deps 和 anchors，图就是空的。缓解：从读证书自动推断候选 deps（来自 OpenViking 和 brain0 从 transcript 推读集的做法）、policy 要求某些 kind 必须锚定、Stop hook 的声明与实际漂移检查
LLM 复核成本与振荡：Sem PENDING 可能积压。缓解：按 (rule, curvec) 签名去重；OpenViking 式按比例阈值延迟重算；SD12 stateless ABA 恢复；可以批量 validate_revision
单 writer 与 co-located 的限制：多机团队共享要到 M4。中心化 lineage 在高延迟链路上会输（B13），产品必须声明为本地 daemon
许可证：Kage（GPL-3.0）和 OpenViking（AGPL-3.0）只能借鉴思路，必须 clean-room 重新实现；Apache/MIT 的项目（mem0、Hindsight、cognee、Graphiti、Letta、Dolt、ai-memory、brain0）可以复用代码，但要保留 NOTICE
git 镜像与 db 漂移：镜像只能导出不能回写。若用户手改 markdown，需要检测并拒绝，或者转为 uc_supersede 提案，否则会出现双真相
hook 平台变动：Claude Code、Codex 的 hook schema 随版本变化。uc-hook 需要适配层和契约测试；daemon 不可达时的 fail 策略必须可配置

scores.strategy: Standalone Rust counting-TMS kernel (SD1-SD17) with SQLite, single-writer daemon, MCP server and Claude Code/Codex hooks, porting only confirmed or partially verified mechanisms
scores.notes: Strongest evidence discipline. It lists refuted and README-only mechanisms explicitly (mem0 linked_memory_ids, Hindsight last_recall, cognee improve, Tencent soft-delete and reconciliation, tigerless exactly-once) and rewrites each borrowed mechanism into ContextDB semantics. The outbox is described as at-least-once plus dedup, which is the honest framing. It also flags that 'ultracode' could not be found and asks the user. The scope is still far too large for one developer in 3 weeks. The 'MVP' includes the full M0+M1a kernel with oracle exact-match, an op-log with snapshot replay, a daemon lease, roughly 9 MCP tools, a full hook suite, a CodeAnchor observer, and cert verify/doctor. Its own roadmap reaches product alpha only at about week 8. The mechanism list is padded: 40+ entries, several of them marginal (PROV-O vocabulary, in-toto, IndexState enum). Product value depends on agents producing usable read-sets and dependencies, and that risk is acknowledged but not solved.

scores.strategy: Sidecar on Hindsight (primary host) with a mem0 shim: UltraCode keeps revisions, heads with CAS, the justification DAG, certificates and the PreToolUse gate; the host keeps extraction and retrieval
scores.notes: Choosing a host on verified grounds is reasonable. OperationValidatorExtension is confirmed, and source_memory_ids and based_on map cleanly to OR and Sem rules. The weakness is that the core integration rests on something nobody verified: whether Hindsight's hard-delete paths (delete_stale_observations) fire any post-hook. The plan itself falls back to a reconcile diff, which creates an observation window and a 'ctxd says SUPPORTED, Hindsight deleted it' divergence that will confuse users. Requiring a Postgres-backed Python host of about 180k lines that changes quickly sharply narrows who can adopt it and makes a 3-week MVP harder, because the kernel and an adapter both need building and testing against a moving API. Differentiation is real but partly diluted, since retrieval and semantics depend on a host whose model conflicts with OR support. Grounding is mostly accurate but leans on a hook path that is unverified.

scores.strategy: UltraCode coding-native: ContextDB kernel plus code anchors (tree-sitter symbol span hashes, three-bucket claim reopen) treated as moving heads, SQLite as truth and git as mirror/branch substrate, PreToolUse and CI gating, warn by default
scores.notes: The best product story for a developer running several coding agents. Code changes and decision supersession go through the same propagation kernel, and agents-remember's three buckets map onto no-op, PENDING and STALE. That combination is the clearest differentiator against the overlap verdicts, and defaulting to warn is a sensible response to memory-graph and ai-memory avoiding gating. It is the least feasible plan, though. The MVP list adds multi-language tree-sitter, a git mirror exporter, an LLM validator worker with contradiction candidates, a CI range check and subagent certificate inheritance on top of the full kernel. The central code-anchor mechanism comes from projects with about 42 stars and is verified only for TS/JS byte-level hashing. 'Multi-language structural fingerprints' is new engineering, not a proven mechanism, although the plan honestly sends it to benchmarking. Grounding is mostly careful (it corrects the Dolt splitter detail and notes Tencent's TOCTOU), but the mechanism list is bloated, about 50 entries, and some adaptations are presented as validated when they are not.

judgements.winner: Standalone Rust counting-TMS kernel (SD1-SD17) with SQLite, single-writer daemon, MCP server and Claude Code/Codex hooks, porting only confirmed or partially verified mechanisms
grafts: From the coding-native strategy: make code anchors the main user-facing use case. Map agents-remember's three-bucket reopen (blob unchanged = no-op, anchor broken = STALE, change outside the cited range = Cur STALE, change inside the range = Sem PENDING) onto CodeAnchor head moves, and use the 'changed is certain, silence is UNKNOWN' rule.

From the coding-native strategy: default the gate to warn, make enforce opt-in per path or tool, and use `uc check --strict` exit codes in CI or pre-push as the hard enforcement point instead of relying only on client-side hooks.

From the coding-native strategy: the Stop-hook declared-vs-actual write-set drift and the dependency admission rule (deps may only reference handles from the session certificate) to reduce undeclared or hallucinated dependencies.
From the sidecar strategy: keep a HostAdapter trait in the design, but defer Hindsight and mem0 adapters to a later phase as importers or projections rather than MVP dependencies.

Cut the 3-week MVP hard: oracle-backed kernel (L0/L1 plus manual Sem validation only), single-writer SQLite with mandatory expected_head CAS, about 5 MCP tools (recall, read, put, why_not, cert_check), SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit-delta and PreToolUse-warn hooks, file-level git blob anchors only. Defer LLM validators, symbol hashing, the git mirror, branches, signing and multi-language support.
Before committing, ask the user to confirm what 'ultracode' refers to. All three strategies had to guess, and an existing codebase would change the integration plan.

scores.strategy: Strategy 1: standalone Rust counting-TMS kernel (full SD1-SD17) + SQLite op log + daemon + MCP + Claude Code/Codex hooks, porting only confirmed/partially-verified mechanisms
scores.notes: This one is the most careful with evidence. It explicitly drops the refuted items (mem0 linked_memory_ids, Hindsight last_recall re-injection, cognee improve tool, Tencent soft-delete and reconcile, agent-memory exactly-once) and corrects the overclaims, for example presenting outbox delivery as at-least-once plus dedup. It also says plainly that 'ultracode' could not be found and asks for clarification. The differentiation claims match the verified overlap verdicts: no analyzed project combines transitive counting invalidation, PENDING, mandatory head CAS and action-time certificates. Feasibility is poor. By its own roadmap Phases 0-2 take about 8 weeks before a product alpha. The 'MVP' bundles full SD1-SD17, oracle golden tests, Pearce-Kelly, op-log replay with snapshots, a blake3 payload store, MCP with 9+ tools, hooks and a CodeAnchor observer, which is far beyond 3 weeks for one developer. The mechanism list is padded: about 45 adoptions, many of them minor. User value is good but generic. Code anchoring is file-level plus TS/JS only, so the coding-specific advantage is thinner than in Strategy 3.

scores.strategy: Strategy 2: UltraCode as a sidecar on Hindsight (primary host) with a mem0 shim; ContextDB kernel adds revisions/CAS/justification/certificates/PreToolUse gate
scores.notes: Choosing Hindsight as host is defensible on the evidence: OperationValidatorExtension and the store seam are confirmed, and source_memory_ids/based_on map neatly onto OR and Sem rules. The weaknesses are serious, though. (1) A developer running several coding agents is unlikely to run a Postgres-backed Hindsight server, so the main value requires adopting a heavy third-party stack. (2) The strategy itself admits that the hard deletes from delete_stale_observations may not fire any hook, so correctness depends on reconcile diffs plus a staleness window. That weakens the certificate guarantee that is supposed to be the selling point. (3) Two sources of truth with conflicting semantics (Hindsight's 'lose one source, delete' vs OR support) will confuse users. (4) It needs the full kernel plus a Python adapter on a fast-moving codebase of about 180k lines with 114 migrations, so 3 weeks is unrealistic. Grounding is mostly correct, but it leans on unverified hook coverage for the host's internal delete paths, and it cites OpenViking uri-guard and deja-vu as gate precedent even though both are only routing or advisory (it does acknowledge this). Differentiation over plain Hindsight is real, but depending on Hindsight reduces it as a standalone product.

scores.strategy: Strategy 3: UltraCode coding-native certified context library — ContextDB kernel + code anchors (tree-sitter symbol span hashes, git blob OID, three-bucket reopen) on the same propagation kernel, SQLite truth + git mirror, PreToolUse warn-default gating
scores.notes: This has the best product framing for the target user. Code changes and decision supersession become the same head-move event, and agents-remember's verified three-bucket logic maps cleanly onto no-op / Sem→PENDING / structural→STALE. That covers the most common failure in multi-agent coding: acting on a plan whose cited code has changed. Differentiation is the strongest of the three, because verdicts confirm that mem0 captures git_sha but never compares it, Kage and agents-remember check items in isolation without propagation, and deja-vu is only advisory. Grounding is honest. It notes that the low-star code-anchor mechanisms (Kage, agents-remember, about 42 stars) need benchmark proof, cites the high-star corroboration, rejects the refuted items and the Graphiti/Letta mistakes, and flags the GPL/AGPL clean-room requirement. The cost is that its MVP is the largest of the three: the full kernel, tree-sitter for 5 languages, a git mirror exporter, an external LLM validator, 10 MCP tools, hooks and CI. A solo developer will not finish that in 3 weeks. It wins on value and differentiation, provided the MVP is cut back hard.

judgements.winner: Strategy 3: UltraCode coding-native certified context library (code anchors on the same propagation kernel, SQLite truth + git mirror, warn-default PreToolUse gating)
grafts: From Strategy 1: shrink the 3-week MVP to S1's narrower code-anchor v1 (file-level git blob OID plus git log --since, with symbol span hashes for TS/JS only). Move multi-language tree-sitter, the git mirror exporter and the LLM validator worker to later phases.

From Strategy 1: make the append-only op log (hash-chained with previous_checksum) the source of truth, with snapshot replay. Keep the ownership lease plus the flock capability probe, and add `ctxdb doctor` oracle sampling as a self-check in production.

From Strategy 1: report the outbox honestly as at-least-once plus dedup keyed on packet_id, and keep the explicit note that 'ultracode' was not found locally, with a request that the user confirm whether it names an existing codebase.

From Strategy 1: in the M0 kernel, implement only the subset that coding anchors need (L0 counting, Cur/Pin/Sem, L1/L2, WHY_NOT). Gate the remaining SD items behind the oracle tests instead of shipping all of SD1-SD17 in week 3.

From Strategy 2: certificates should carry a watermark that says how stale they may be (reconcile or observer epoch, plus last anchor scan time), so that a check against unsynced code or host state reports UNKNOWN/PENDING and never a false VALID.
From Strategy 2: keep the mem0/Hindsight adapters as Phase-7 importers or API shims, not as hosts. Reuse the Hindsight source_memory_ids→OR-rule and based_on→Sem-rule mapping for import.
Add a measurable success criterion from S1/S2: track the false-deny rate and the legitimate-action allow rate in dogfooding before enforce mode can be opted into.

scores.strategy: S1: Standalone Rust counting-TMS kernel (full SD1-SD17) + SQLite op log + daemon + MCP + hooks, borrowing only confirmed/partially-verified mechanisms
scores.notes: Strongest evidence discipline of the three. It lists refuted mechanisms explicitly (mem0 linked_memory_ids, Hindsight last_recall, cognee improve, Tencent soft-delete and reconcile, tigerless exactly-once, Dolt CommitHook veto) and rewrites each borrowed mechanism into ContextDB semantics: delete becomes Retract/STALE, LWW becomes mandatory CAS. It is also the only strategy that says plainly 'ultracode' was not found locally and asks the user. The differentiation claims follow the overlap verdicts: Dolt cannot combine multi-head CAS with preconditions, Graphiti never persists invalidated_by, and cognee's fixpoint only fires on hard delete. Feasibility is poor. The 'MVP' bundles the full M0+M1a kernel with oracle goldens, op-log persistence and replay, a daemon lease, 9 MCP tools, a hook package, a CodeAnchor observer with TS/JS symbol hashing, lanes and a validator worker. Its own roadmap says Phases 0-2 take about 8 weeks, so this is not a 3-week solo MVP. A few adoptions are padding for an MVP: brain0 in-toto attestations, the PROV-O hash chain, the OpenViking IndexState enum.

scores.strategy: S2: UltraCode as a sidecar on Hindsight (primary host) and mem0 (shim): host does storage/retrieval, UltraCode adds revisions, CAS, justification DAG, certificates, PreToolUse gate
scores.notes: Choosing Hindsight as host is defensible on the evidence: OperationValidatorExtension, the store seam, source_memory_ids/based_on and the retracted-grounding allowlist are all confirmed. The plan still depends on things that are unverified or that conflict. Nothing shows delete_stale_observations firing a post-hook, which the strategy admits and patches with a reconciler. Hindsight's any-source-lost hard delete also conflicts with ContextDB's OR support, so ctxd and the host will disagree about what still exists. For a developer running several coding agents, adopting means running Hindsight's Postgres, LLM pipeline and ~180k-line Python stack before any gating value shows up. That narrows the audience and stacks on two fast-moving codebases. Feasibility is the worst of the three: the MVP needs the kernel and oracle, ctxd, hooks, multi-language tree-sitter pins and a Python Hindsight adapter with mapping semantics and reconcile, all in three weeks. Grounding is mostly correct. Citing OpenViking's uri-guard 'deny' as gate precedent is fair. Mapping every observation source edge to Sem by default is an untested modeling choice.

scores.strategy: S3: UltraCode coding-native product: ContextDB kernel + code anchors (symbol span hash / blob OID) as head-moving logicals in the same propagation kernel, SQLite truth + git mirror/branch substrate, hooks/CI gating warn-by-default
scores.notes: This is the best fit for the stated user: a developer running several coding agents who wants proven ideas pulled together into ultracode. Making a code change and a decision supersession the same event in one propagation kernel is the sharpest differentiator. The overlap verdicts back it: mem0 captures git_sha but never compares it, Kage and agents-remember judge each item in isolation, deja-vu only advises. The three-bucket mapping is concrete and grounded in confirmed agents-remember claim_reopen behavior: no-op, Sem leads to PENDING, structural break leads to STALE. It is candid that the symbol-anchor and claim-reopen evidence comes from 42-star projects, offers high-star corroboration, and puts a replay benchmark on the roadmap. It fixes verified defects instead of copying them: mem0's dir lane, the ledger's INSERT OR IGNORE, Tencent's TOCTOU and Mongo dropped writes, the agent-memory memory_correct bypass, lease fencing. Grounding loses a little because several 'how_used' items lean on partially-verified pieces (Kage's non-atomic ratify, Letta's LocalBackend-only delta) and on Dolt's multi-head+precondition combination, which Dolt itself does not provide; ContextDB would have to build it. Feasibility is the main weakness. The MVP lists tree-sitter for 5 languages, a git mirror, subagent certificate inheritance, handoff, and an LLM validator worker with contradiction candidates on top of the full kernel. That is a quarter of work, not three weeks. It also never raises the 'ultracode' ambiguity with the user.

judgements.winner: S3: UltraCode coding-native product (ContextDB kernel + code anchors unified into the same propagation kernel, SQLite truth + git mirror, hook/CI gating warn-by-default)
grafts: From S1: say explicitly that no 'ultracode' codebase was found under ~/Dev or the ContextDB directory. Ask the user whether it is a product name or an existing repo to integrate before you commit to the architecture.

From S1: keep the phasing (M0 contract+oracle, then M1a counting kernel with a zero-mismatch exit gate, then product alpha) and the 'kernel API frozen, product layer must not slow the M1 exit gate' rule.

Cut S3's 3-week MVP to: in-memory kernel + oracle check, SQLite single-writer append-only op log, mandatory expected_head/create_only CAS returning {expected,current}, 5 MCP tools (recall via FTS5, read, record, supersede, check), session read-ledger certificates, PreToolUse warn-only (<=480B) plus UserPromptSubmit <context_update> delta, and code anchors at git-blob/file level only via the post-commit/checkout hook. Defer tree-sitter symbol spans, the git mirror, the LLM validator, handoff, subagent inheritance and branches.

From S1: list rejected/refuted mechanisms explicitly next to each adoption (mem0 linked_memory_ids, Hindsight last_recall, cognee improve, Dolt CommitHook veto, tigerless exactly-once) so the evidence trail can be audited.
From S2: certificates should carry an ingestion/reconcile watermark, so a certificate states how stale its view of external sources (git, hosts) might be instead of implying completeness.

From S2: keep Hindsight/mem0 adapters as a later ecosystem phase, not the core path: map source_memory_ids to OR rules and based_on to Sem rules, and reuse the retracted-grounding 'unresolvable' guard for imports.

From S3's own risk list, promote it to an MVP deliverable: a commit-history replay benchmark that measures false invalidation and false-deny rates for code anchors, since the anchor mechanism rests on 42-star evidence.
